final: WITH counts AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, j.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY m.link_to_major, j.department), total AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS n FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT c.major_id, c.department, c.member_count, CAST(c.member_count AS REAL) / t.n AS share FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.n IS NOT NULL), department_averages AS (SELECT department, AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares GROUP BY department) SELECT s.major_id, s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.average_share FROM shares AS s JOIN department_averages AS a ON s.department = a.department COLLATE BINARY WHERE s.share > a.average_share ORDER BY s.share - a.average_share DESC LIMIT 10
